messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for inference-proxy-5xx-eu (PD-3321). rule=5xx-rate-eu, threshold=2.5%, observed=4.7%. auto-escalate in 2m unless acked.

erin: acked. i'm on it, pulling dashboards and support queue.

jas: looking at metrics — spike is very short, ~25s, concentrated from internal IP block labeled synthetic-tests. no support tickets opened.

ravi: deploy-bot says no deploys in last 45m.

chao: logs snippet: ````
[2024-06-18T09:10:12Z] host=eu-proxy-12 src=10.8.9.11 route=/v1/embeddings status=502 upstream_err=true
[2024-06-18T09:10:13Z] host=eu-proxy-07 src=10.8.9.14 route=/v1/generate status=504 upstream_timeout=true
````

jas: count by source_tag: synthetic-tests ~ 92% of affected, customer_ips ~ 3 requests. so customer impact minimal. preliminary verdict: NO_CUSTOMER_IMPACT.

erin: any autoscaling events?

ravi: no autoscale. KV prefill logs show elevated miss-rate at 09:10:05-09:10:40 for model-b shards in eu-west. looks like concurrent prefill attempts + canary ramp.

chao: hypothesis: synthetic ramp hit cold shard causing transient backend errors while prefill/kv warmed. short-lived but triggered alert due to low bucketing window.

jas: paging timeline: fired -> ack (erin) -> investigate -> resolved automatically by PD at 3312345710 per webhook.

pagerduty-bot: PD-3321 auto-resolved at 3312345710; condition returned to normal.

erin: confirmed resolved. creating follow-up: INF-2045 to adjust alert bucketing and add synthetic source isolation. adding runbook action to check KV prefill miss rate as early step.

ravi: suggested fixes: 1) add 45s rolling window for 5xx alert rather than 15s; 2) tag/exclude synthetic sources from alerting OR add separate synthetic alert; 3) add guard in alert rule to require kv_prefill_miss_rate > 0.1 before paging.

chao: also propose a small backoff in canary traffic generator to prefill KVs before ramp. will add to INF-2045.

jas: quick runbook draft (to include in INF-2045):
- check deploy bot: `deploy-bot status`
- inspect logs for upstream 5xx patterns (sample query)
- check kv_prefill misses dashboard (panel: kv.misses by shard)
- confirm customer impact via support queue and error aggregation
- if synthetic-only, snooze alert and file follow-up

erin: i'll apply a 20m snooze to inference-proxy-5xx-eu in prod while we test rule changes in staging.

ops-bot: Snooze applied: inference-proxy-5xx-eu for 20 minutes by erin.

jas: closing thread — customer impact=none, source=synthetic canary + kv cold warmup, follow-up INF-2045 filed. :white_check_mark:

erin: thanks team, nice fast triage. closing handoff to infra for alert tuning. :thumbsup:
